title: S1CogBench: What System One Decision Models Can and Cannot Do on Cognitive Experiments
author: Dengzhe Hou, Kazunori D Yamada
description: Decision-making in humans and AI involves multiple cognitive abilities. System One decision models produce fast, structured choices. summary: Decision-making in humans and AI involves multiple cognitive abilities. System One decision models produce fast, structured choices.
takeaways: We introduce S1CogBench, a benchmark of 24 established cognitive tasks and 27 evaluation modes, evaluating seven open models and the API model Jev.

In these models, strong performance on some learning tasks coexists with failures to gather information or adapt to feedback, while high accuracy does not guarantee human-like responses to changing task demands.
To our knowledge, S1CogBench is the first benchmark of System One decision models on established cognitive experiments.
